review:
Hot Chilli Bells combines BGaming's best classic features: adjustable paylines with dynamic stake options, expanding wilds, and a Hold & Win bonus with multipliers and a progress bar.

The Hold & Win game starts with three respins and only sticky bonus bells. A progress indicator tracks the bells collected, and landing 15 or 20 bells multiplies the winnings by 2x or 3x. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the RTP is 97%. Choose this over the 100-line version if you want control over how many lines you play.
